react-mnemonic

Compact rules for coding agents:

- Import values and types from "react-mnemonic" only.
- Do not create local .d.ts files for react-mnemonic.
- Do not write `declare module "react-mnemonic"`.
- Do not import from dist/* or internal private paths.
- If types seem missing, inspect package exports and API docs before inventing shims.
- Persist only durable state.
- Use set(null) for durable clear intent.
- Use remove() to forget a key.
- Use reset() to persist defaultValue again.
- Use schema migration for structural upgrades and reconcile(...) for read-time policy refreshes.
- SSR defaults to defaultValue; use ssr.serverValue and hydration: "client-only" when needed.

Canonical references:

- docs/ai/quick-rules.md
- website/docs/guides/ai-contract-guide.md
- website/static/ai-contract.json
- src/index.ts
- package.json
